triggers.definition: CREATE TRIGGER set_pcb_designer_model_assets_updated_at BEFORE UPDATE ON workspace.pcb_designer_model_assets FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION workspace.set_pcb_designer_updated_at()

constraints.name: pcb_designer_shared_library_state_check
constraints.definition: CHECK ((((payload IS NOT NULL) AND (deleted_at IS NULL) AND (component_updated_at IS NOT NULL)) OR ((payload IS NULL) AND (deleted_at IS NOT NULL))))

constraints.name: pcb_designer_shared_library_updated_by_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (updated_by) REFERENCES workspace.system_users(id) ON DELETE SET NULL

constraints.name: pcb_designer_workspaces_owner_id_fkey
